title: Exercises in Knitting
author: Cornelia Mee

authorInfo.bio: Cornelia Mee (1815–1875) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Exercises in Knitting" by Cornelia Mee is a practical guide on knitting techniques written in the mid-19th century. The work presents various knitting patterns along with detailed instructions on how to create items such as chair covers, bags, and garments.
